name: QIDI ABS Rapido @Creality CR-10 Smart
filament_notes:
QIDI manufacturer data, generated by scripts/shop_profiles/gen_filaments.py.
Dry 80 C for 6 h.
Manufacturer max speed 80 mm/s.
Manufacturer recommends an enclosure; this printer is open-frame.
Comparison guide: nozzle 220-250 C, bed 90-110 C textured PEI, 40-80 mm/s, fan 0-80 %, drying 70-80 C 4-6 h, any nozzle 0.2-0.8 mm, closed chamber required. Product page: 'Enclosure Printers Required', 'Active chamber heating recommended' (no number). Chamber 50 C and density 1.05 from older wiki table, which listed nozzle 250-280 C, bed 100 C, fan 30 %, drying 60 C 4-6 h, annealing 80-90 C 6-12 h. Nozzle range conflicts between sources. TDS PDF in QIDI Drive folder.
Source: https://qidi3d.com/products/qidi-tech-abs-filament
